title: Installation Instructions for Phylogenetic Analysis Using a Conda Environment
author: Laise Moraes
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgd4js8w

steps.title: Install Miniconda
steps.instruction: Install the 64-bit Python 3 Miniconda installer into a dedicated softwares directory in the HOME directory.

substeps.instruction: Create and enter a directory called softwares in the HOME directory: mkdir $HOME/softwares && cd $HOME/softwares
Install Miniconda quietly accepting defaults: bash Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh -bfp $HOME/softwares/conda
Remove the installer file: rm Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh

steps.title: Configure Environment Path and Update Conda
steps.instruction: Set the permanent PATH for Miniconda and update the base conda packages.

substeps.instruction: Make the PATH permanent by adding it to .bashrc: echo 'export PATH="$HOME/softwares/conda/bin:/usr/local/share/rsi/idl/bin:$PATH"' >> $HOME/.bashrc
Update conda packages to the latest compatible version: conda update -y -n base conda

steps.title: Create Environment Configuration File
steps.instruction: Create a YML file named phy.yml to define the phylogenetic analysis environment.

steps.title: Build Phylogenetic Analysis Environment
steps.instruction: Create the conda environment using the previously created YML file.
